NONE: › abbreviation for high-definition television (= a type of television that shows clear, high-quality pictures on a wider screen than standard television)
高畫質電視（high-definition television的縮寫）
› HDTV is also the programs you watch or the business of broadcasting them.
高畫質電視節目；高畫質電視節目播出

example: [ C ] Consumers have bought 10 million HDTVs but have found little to watch.
消費者購買了一千萬台高畫質電視機，但卻沒有多少相應的節目可看。
[ U ] There’s no HDTV on our local channels.
我們的本地頻道上沒有高畫質節目。
